tokens.name: asphalt
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text and headlines on trim and mustard; the street, roofs, curbs, buttons, address plates and the night field (Watch + Eat, footer).

tokens.name: asphalt-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface inside an asphalt field: the active row in a video menu, a pressed tab.

tokens.name: trim
tokens.usage: Window trim. Reading ground for long text, the casing around every photo, and the paper behind Tina's notes. Text on blue, green, brick and asphalt fields.

tokens.name: trim-2
tokens.usage: Weathered trim. Quiet dividers on trim, the ground of sponsored slots, inset photo casings.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, captions) on trim and trim-2. 8.0:1 on trim.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Dashed outlines for not-yet states (unclaimed, not visited, empty lot) and input placeholders on trim. 4.9:1 on trim; never body copy.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: Signature siding. The front door of the brand: home hero, the Sunday list, Shrewsbury Street. Always carries asphalt text (8.7:1), never trim.

tokens.name: mustard-ink
tokens.usage: Secondary text and dashed outlines on mustard (6.8:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Porch blue siding. Downtown places, guide sections, verified-business label. Trim text on it (8.5:1).

tokens.name: blue-lt
tokens.usage: Faded blue clapboard for suburban towns and map water. Asphalt text only.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Porch green siding. Park Ave and west-side places, people stories. Trim text on it (7.2:1).

tokens.name: green-lt
tokens.usage: Faded green clapboard for suburban towns. Asphalt text only.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Brick. Canal District places and the editorial-policy sign. Trim text on it (6.8:1).

tokens.name: brick-lt
tokens.usage: Faded brick for suburban towns. Asphalt text only.

tokens.name: tina
tokens.usage: Tina's marker. Only for her handwriting, her signature and the 'Tina ate here' stamp. Never a button, link or ad. 4.6:1 on trim; fails on every siding color, so it always sits on trim paper.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px asphalt outline at 2px offset plus a 5px trim halo, so one of the two reads at 3:1+ on trim, mustard, every siding color and asphalt.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page. Archivo at width 125. Page thesis only: the craving question, a place name, the policy sign.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Guide covers, stop names, small section heads. Archivo width 118.

styles.name: sentence
styles.sample: I want something spicy in Worcester
styles.usage: The craving sentence. Archivo width 112; slots at weight 830 with a 0.12em asphalt underline.

styles.name: house-number
styles.usage: Address numerals on plates, houses and map pins. Archivo at width 62 (condensed). Numerals only.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Every place she actually sat down in, with the one thing she'd tell you to order.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tina pays for her meals unless we say otherwise, right on the page.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav, place names in lists. Archivo width 100–108.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Addresses, cuisine, price band, freshness lines. ink-2 on trim.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Get the Brussels sprouts. Trust me.
styles.usage: Tina's one-line notes on trim paper, rotated about -2°. One per view. Ten words or fewer.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: Dish verdicts under What Tina ordered.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside small labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Window casing on small photos; gap inside button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between houses on a street; gap between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Floor padding inside a house; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a photo and its information.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between paired columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of a field (section) on desktop; 56px on phones.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, fields, windows, inputs, labels. Clapboard is square.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Address plates and map pins only, like an enamel house number.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The play button and the route-stop dots. Nothing else.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows, floors and list items.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Floor lines on a place page, map frame, input borders are 2px.

tokens.name: rule-roof
tokens.usage: The roof cap on a house module; 14px cornice under a field.
